description: This file defines an Android activity named Bouncer3 which contains a custom view MyView. The MyView class handles rendering a bitmap and animates its vertical position using an ObjectAnimator when clicked, creating a bouncing visual effect.

classes.name: Bouncer3
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up the layout for the bouncing animation.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Custom view subclass that manages a bitmap and handles its animation when clicked.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets its content view.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal position of the shape and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Sets the vertical position of the shape and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Initializes the bitmap and shape dimensions, and sets click listener to start animation.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in view size, initializes shape position.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at its current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts the ObjectAnimator to animate the shape vertically infinitely.

methods.name: getObjectAnimator
methods.description: Creates and returns an ObjectAnimator targeting 'shapeY' property from 0 to the bottom of the view.
